mit_living_wage.author: Dr. Amy Glasmeier / Massachusetts Institute of Technology
mit_living_wage.methodological_divergence: MIT Living Wage includes civic engagement expenses, unsubsidized commercial healthcare premiums, and county-level cost aggregation, whereas The Foundation Survival Floor models bare-minimum survival needs assuming ACA subsidies and strict home meal preparation.
mit_living_wage.name: MIT Living Wage Calculator

official_poverty_measure.author: U.S. Census Bureau / U.S. Dept. of Health & Human Services
official_poverty_measure.methodological_divergence: The OPM is based on the 1963 food-to-income multiplier (3x food) indexed by headline CPI-U. It severely underestimates modern housing, transportation, utility, and healthcare requirements.
official_poverty_measure.name: Official Poverty Measure (OPM)

united_way_alice.author: United Way
united_way_alice.methodological_divergence: ALICE includes an explicit 10% miscellaneous contingency reserve and higher technology allowances. When ALICE contingency is excluded, the baseline aligns closely with The Foundation's $27,960 estimate.
united_way_alice.name: United For ALICE Household Survival Budget

components.method: National baseline for 40th-percentile efficiency/1-bedroom rental unit including essential utilities.
components.notes: Housing cost varies substantially by region; national baseline represents median cross-market entry rental.
components.source_agency: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) / Census
components.source_name: Fair Market Rents (FMR) & ACS Median Gross Rent

components.method: USDA monthly cost of food for single adult (age 19-50) with official +20% 1-person household size adjustment.
components.notes: Assumes 100% home meal preparation using low-cost, nutritious staple food basket.
components.source_agency: U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Food and Nutrition Service

components.method: Basic household electric, heating/cooling, water/sewer, and minimum broadband connectivity baseline.
components.notes: Reflects unavoidable residential utility costs not included in base rent.
components.source_name: Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS) & CE Survey

components.method: Basic operating costs for reliable used commuting vehicle (fuel, liability insurance, basic maintenance) or transit pass.
components.notes: Does not assume new vehicle purchase or comprehensive insurance.
components.source_name: Consumer Expenditure Survey (CE) - Lowest Two Income Quintiles

components.method: Out-of-pocket medical expenses plus subsidized ACA benchmark Silver health insurance premium.
components.notes: Assumes eligibility for income-based Affordable Care Act premium tax credits (APTC).
components.source_agency: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ) / CMS
components.source_name: Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS) & ACA Benchmark Subsidies

components.method: Mandatory FICA payroll taxes (7.65% on earned income) plus state/local sales taxes and unavoidable personal hygiene/cleaning supplies.
components.notes: Assumes standard deduction eliminates federal income tax liability at this earnings level.
components.source_name: FICA Statutory Payroll Tax & BLS Essential Household Supplies
